summary: #2209 (bot pin bump to 0.39.0) superseded by AISDLC-1142 (DEC-0278 link-versions); 574 fix-on-PR brief withdrawn after two failed re-sign rounds

options.description: Withdraw the 574 fix-on-PR brief; #2209 stays open for the operator to close; AISDLC-1142 carries the pin change
Keep the brief and re-enter #2209 once more to get main green before 1142

body: PR #2209 bumps both plugin manifests from >=0.38.0 to >=0.39.0 and fails only on attestation (contentHashV4 mismatch) plus the governance gate riding on it. Two developer rounds under the tasks-aisdlc-574-fix-2209 brief did not produce a valid envelope; dispatch holds a loop guard on the unchanged head. AISDLC-1142 implements DEC-0278 (exact release-linked pins, pin-sync job deleted) and names #2209 as 'lands first or is superseded'. Operator chose supersede via the planner rubric 2026-11-01. Class (a): reversible (re-add the brief entry), small blast radius, no governance control changed. Cost: main-health stays red on plugin-pins until 1142 lands. Closing #2209 itself stays operator-only (class c).
